txt_en: Kind words can be short and easy to speak, but their echoes are truly endless.
txt_cn: 善良的话语或许很简短，很简单，但产生的回响却是无穷止尽。
author: Mother Teresa

txt_en: What lies behind you and what lies in front of you, pales in comparison to what lies inside of you.
txt_cn: 无论是你的过去，还是将来，与你的内在相比，都微不足道。
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

txt_en: Success is the sum of small efforts — repeated day in and day out.
txt_cn: 成功就是日复一日那一点点小小努力的积累。
author: Robert Collier

txt_en: Climb mountains not so the world can see you, but so you can see the world.
txt_cn: 爬上山顶并不是为了让世界看到你，而是为了让你看到整个世界。
author: David McCullough Jr.

txt_en: Don't go through life; grow through life.
txt_cn: 别只是过活，要通过生活获得成长。
author: Eric Butterworth

txt_en: Appreciation is a wonderful thing. It makes what is excellent in others belong to us as well.
txt_cn: 欣赏是一件美妙的事，它让别人的优点也成为我们自己的。
author: 伏尔泰

txt_en: Here's to a vacation of no regrets!
author: Joan Rylen

txt_en: Magic is believing in yourself; if you can do that, you can make anything happen.
txt_cn: 相信自己是种魔法，能做到这一点，就可以实现任何事。
author: 歌德

txt_en: Happiness is not by chance, but by choice.
txt_cn: 幸福靠的不是运气，而是选择。
author: Jim Rohn

txt_en: If life throws you a few bad notes or vibrations, don't let them interrupt or alter your song.
txt_cn: 即便生活给了你一些不和谐的音符，也别让它们破坏你的人生之歌。
author: Suzy Kassem

txt_en: The most wasted of all days is one without laughter.
txt_cn: 没有欢笑的一天便最是虚度。
author: E. E. Cummings

txt_en: One man with courage makes a majority.
txt_cn: 若有勇气，一个人抵得上千军万马。
author: Andrew Jackson
